stories.tldr: WWE is moving forward with the upcoming John Cena Classic tournament, which will feature a mix of main roster and NXT talent. John Cena recently provided an update noting that all event details are now finalized behind the scenes, though an official announcement is still being withheld. Additional details reveal the tournament winner will be decided by a fan vote, and the previously rumored December date faces potential scheduling conflicts. Furthermore, Cena firmly reiterated that he will never return to the ring for another match.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Pays Tribute To Sasha Banks Persona At AEW All In Afterparty
stories.tldr: After capturing the AEW Women's World Championship at Wembley Stadium despite suffering a broken nose, Mercedes Mone celebrated her victory at a local afterparty. During the post-show festivities, the newly crowned champion stepped behind the DJ booth and treated fans to a nostalgic surprise. Mone closed her set by playing her former WWE entrance theme song, Sky's the Limit. She is set to bring her official championship celebration to this week's episode of AEW Dynamite.

stories.title: Former WWE star EC3 announces that he has been hospitalized
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Champion EC3 was hospitalized following a severe leg infection he contracted after attending a gathering in the woods. After initially being turned away and suffering through five days of worsening symptoms, he was finally admitted for treatment. He is currently resting in the hospital, passing the time by watching movies and asking fans to send positive vibes instead of text messages.

stories.title: AJ Styles Explains What Son Avery Styles Can Learn In TNA Wrestling
stories.tldr: AJ Styles is weighing in on his son Avery officially signing with TNA Wrestling while continuing to take independent bookings. The veteran father and current WWE backstage producer emphasized that TNA will give the teenage rookie crucial television experience, particularly in learning how to hit strict time limits and commercial breaks. Avery's fast-tracked entry into the business has sparked some industry discussions about paying dues, but promoters like Brett Lauderdale remain confident in his talent and growth.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale Issues Emotional Message After Losing AEW Women’s World Title
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship loss to Mercedes Mone at Wembley Stadium, Willow Nightingale shared an emotional statement on social media reflecting on the grueling encounter. Nightingale revealed she competed through the physical toll of the match, having already entered the event with a broken hand. Despite the heartbreaking defeat, the former champion vowed to eventually smile again and keep pushing forward.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Says WWE Pause “Killed Our Momentum,” Talks Alexa Bliss/Braun Strowman & Wyatt Sicks Reunion Plans
stories.tldr: Beyond the creative reluctance to feature the faction without Bo Dallas, Joe Gacy revealed that WWE rejected pitches for individual character vignettes and unused dialogue-heavy VHS tapes. The group had hoped to operate similarly to The Judgment Day by branching into separate storylines. Additionally, creative internally discussed eventually adding Braun Strowman and Alexa Bliss to the stable at various points.

stories.title: News regarding the impression Kofi and Austin Creed made with people backstage at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Following their debut as The New Level at AEW All In, Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed immediately won over the backstage locker room. Sources praised the duo for being humble, approachable, and eager to introduce themselves without any ego. Tony Khan also revealed that both wrestlers requested a heavy weekly schedule similar to Jon Moxley to prove their strong work ethic.

stories.title: AJ Styles explains how son Avery will benefit from joining TNA
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently weighed in on his son Avery joining TNA, emphasizing that the television environment will teach the rookie crucial skills like hitting time cues and working around commercial breaks. Avery will balance his new TNA commitments with independent dates, including an upcoming appearance at Wrestling Revolver. The teenager has already debuted in a TNA dark match against Brian Myers and is currently part of an on-screen storyline with Frankie Kazarian acting as a heel mentor.

stories.title: Former AEW Champion addresses All In loss: ‘Let’s keep pushing forward’
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship loss to Mercedes Mone at Wembley Stadium, former champion Willow Nightingale has broken her silence on social media. Nightingale addressed the defeat on X, reflecting on the physical toll of competing with a broken hand and giving her all. Despite the heartbreaking setback, she vowed to keep pushing forward and eventually smile again.

stories.title: What is being said about Kevin Owens potentially suffering an injury at a WWE live event
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens sparked injury concerns over the weekend after needing physical assistance to the backstage area following a live event match in South Carolina. Initial backstage reactions within the company varied, with some talent suspecting it was merely in-ring selling while others feared a legitimate setback. Fortunately, subsequent wrestling observer updates have clarified the situation and confirmed that Owens is completely okay with no actual injury.

stories.title: Injured Former WWE Title-Holder Addresses Rumors: “Reports Are Greatly Exaggerated …”
stories.tldr: Piper Niven is setting the record straight regarding speculation about her in-ring future. Niven has been sidelined since August 2025 due to a neck injury, and despite providing several updates on her recovery through social media, rumors recently surfaced suggesting that the WWE star had retired fr

stories.title: Will Ospreay Gets Emotional Reflecting On Historic AEW World Title Win At Wembley
stories.tldr: Following his historic AEW World Championship win over Kenny Omega at Wembley Stadium, a visibly emotional Will Ospreay admitted in the post-show press conference that the immense self-imposed pressure nearly overwhelmed him all week. He reflected on the significance of being the first British wrestler to win a major world title on home soil and praised Omega as the greatest wrestler of their generation. Looking forward, Ospreay expressed a desire to headline more big-money events while also addressing his complicated relationship with United Empire stablemate Callum Newman.

stories.title: New Level Open Up On WWE Departure & Reveal Major Reason Why They Joined AEW
stories.tldr: Formerly known as Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods in WWE, The New Level explained during the All In media scrum that they left because they had simply outgrown their relationship with the company. Austin Creed revealed that AEW's strong emphasis on tag team wrestling was the primary reason for their signing, a sentiment echoed by Kofi. Meanwhile, Swerve Strickland shared how Kofi's past WWE Championship win inspired his own career, and Tony Khan detailed waiting until their non-compete clauses expired before reaching out.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Gets Emotional Discussing AEW Women’s Title Win, Confirms Broken Nose & Stitches
stories.tldr: Following her AEW Women's World Championship victory over Willow Nightingale at Wembley Stadium, a visibly emotional Mercedes Moné addressed the media with a broken nose and fresh stitches. Moné suffered the injury early in the match but fought through it to secure the title and make history as a multi-promotion world champion. During the post-show press conference, she reflected on her journey, her desire to elevate women's wrestling, and her upcoming celebration on Dynamite.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff believes that New Day becoming New Level is “the cheap way out”
stories.tldr: Following their AEW debut as The New Level, former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed have drawn a critical reaction from WWE Hall of Famer Eric Bischoff. Speaking on his podcast, Bischoff slammed the team's name change and transition as the cheap way out, arguing that leaning into their former New Day identity is a derivative move. Drawing from his own WCW experience, Bischoff explained that talent should focus on building authentic, brand-new characters rather than trying to draft off past WWE equity.

stories.title: Tony Khan’s AEW All In Scrum: When He Began Talking To New Level, PPV Buys, “Best Week In AEW History”
stories.tldr: Following All In at Wembley Stadium, Tony Khan revealed during the post-show media scrum that the event set a company record for pay-per-view buys on HBO Max and generated a six million dollar gate. Khan detailed the timeline of when he finally contacted Kofi and Austin Creed after their free agency window closed, and confirmed that AEW will definitely return to Wembley in the future. He also discussed the Motor City Machine Guns signing, his perspective on the media landscape, and his thoughts on Will Ospreay's mainstream morning television appearance.

stories.title: Injured WWE star clarifies retirement rumors amid recovery
stories.tldr: Piper Niven was sidelined with a neck injury in August 2025. Despite her frequent health updates on social media, rumors began to emerge that she had retired from pro wrestling. Niven responded to a fan’s post on X asking the WWE star about the authenticity of the speculation. Niven denied retiremen

stories.title: Will Ospreay addresses ‘mind blowing’ AEW All In tribute featuring ghosts from his wrestling past
stories.tldr: Following his historic AEW World Championship victory over Kenny Omega at Wembley Stadium, newly crowned champion Will Ospreay reflected on a deeply emotional entrance tribute. Speaking at the post show media scrum, Ospreay discussed how surreal it was to encounter key figures from his career history, including Zack Sabre Jr, Ricochet, Jon Moxley, and his wife Alex Windsor. He also credited his mother for providing the powerful voiceover for the introductory vignette that chronicled his long wrestling journey.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone pays tribute to Sasha Banks at AEW All In afterparty
stories.tldr: Newly crowned AEW Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone celebrated her All In victory at a London afterparty by trying her hand at DJing and playing her old WWE Sasha Banks theme song. Despite suffering a broken nose during her title win over Willow Nightingale, Mone is still scheduled for a championship celebration on the next episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Darby Allin Wins TNT Championship at AEW All In with Return of Sting
stories.tldr: At AEW All In from Wembley Stadium, Darby Allin defeated Kevin Knight in a brutal falls count anywhere match to capture his third TNT Championship, ending Knight's 140-day reign. The bout featured extreme high-risk spots, including a massive Coffin Drop through the stage truss and another onto a stretcher to avenge Knight's prior betrayal at Double or Nothing. The match also saw a surprise return from wrestling legend Sting and his son Steven Borden, who helped neutralize interference from the Don Callis Family. Post-match, Allin revealed that his first TNT title win meant even more to him than his first AEW World title because it gave him the insecure early-career confidence that he truly belonged in the company.

stories.title: AEW Announces Dynasty 2027 International Location and London O2 Show
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has officially announced that the 2027 Dynasty pay-per-view will take place on February 7 at the M&S Bank Arena in Liverpool, England, marking the company's first-ever event in the city and its earliest PPV date in history. Following the event, AEW will remain in England to host a February 10 episode of Dynamite at The O2 Arena in London, which will be the venue's first time hosting a Dynamite broadcast. This scheduling shift for Dynasty, moving from its traditional April window to February, has sparked speculation regarding how it might impact the 2027 calendar, including potential changes to the Revolution PPV and counter-programming strategies against WWE's WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia. Additionally, the company is expanding its international footprint with its upcoming AEW Grand Slam France tapings in Paris this October.

stories.title: MVP Contract Extension Details with AEW
stories.tldr: MVP has signed a long-term contract extension with All Elite Wrestling that runs through age 57, ensuring his future with the company as a manager, mouthpiece, and consultant. While he remains open to a final in-ring match likely taking place next year, he has largely stepped away from active wrestling and physical bumps. Meanwhile, MVP recently missed AEW All In at Wembley Stadium due to ongoing visa issues affecting his international travel. Despite his absence, his Hurt Syndicate stablemates Bobby Lashley and Shelton Benjamin successfully competed on the event.

stories.title: Rush Issues Statement on Absence from AEW All In
stories.tldr: AEW star Rush has issued a public statement addressing his absence from the AEW All In 2026 event. Despite joining the company in 2022, El Toro Blanco has yet to compete on the promotion's biggest stage at Wembley Stadium. Rush expressed maturity and gratitude regarding the situation while confirming that he remains focused on his future opportunities. He has been absent from television since early July following a series of high-profile matches earlier in the summer.

stories.title: Tony Khan Explains Signing Motor City Machine Guns
stories.tldr: Tony Khan recently explained that signing the Motor City Machine Guns, Chris Sabin and Alex Shelley, was an easy decision once they became available as free agents. Khan, a longtime fan of the legendary tag team, seized the opportunity to debut them in front of their hometown fans in Detroit before bringing them to AEW television at All In. There, they immediately inserted themselves into the world tag team title picture by confronting champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage. Now positioned alongside top tier teams like FTR and The Young Bucks, Sabin and Shelley are poised for a major championship chase in AEW.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher Recreates Shawn Michaels Spot at All In
stories.tldr: At AEW All In: London, Kyle Fletcher defended the International Championship in a triple threat match against Don Callis Family stablemates Kazuchika Okada and Konosuke Takeshita. Fletcher paid homage to Shawn Michaels by immediately landing a surprise superkick on Okada to kick off the bout, echoing the famous WWE Survivor Series 2009 betrayal spot. Despite a hard-fought 13-minute contest featuring nearfalls and attempted screwdriver tactics, Okada ultimately pinned Fletcher following a Rainmaker to capture the title. Following the match, Don Callis joined the celebration, and Okada forced a defeated Fletcher to raise his hand in acknowledgement of the new champion.

stories.title: Bryan Danielson Returns at AEW All In Zero Hour
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion Bryan Danielson made a surprise return during the Zero Hour pre-show at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. Danielson joined the announce desk ahead of the TBS title match and reflected on previously winning the world title at the venue against Swerve Strickland. He had been away from television since April due to physical wear and tear that prompted Tony Khan to grant him time off to heal.

stories.title: The New Level (Kofi Kingston & Austin Creed) Debut in AEW at All In
stories.tldr: Former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed debuted as The New Level at AEW All In, teaming with Swerve Strickland to capture the World Trios Championships on their very first night. During the post-show media scrum, the duo explained their departure from WWE and the inspiration behind their new team name. Additionally, Tony Khan revealed that he waited until their non-compete clauses expired before unexpected contract talks came together just in time for the pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Wins AEW World Championship at All In
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay defeated Kenny Omega in a brutal main event at AEW All In 2026 to capture the AEW World Championship at Wembley Stadium. The historic victory made him the first English wrestler to win a world title on home soil after surviving a grueling match filled with massive kick-outs and near-falls. Following the emotional triumph, Ospreay opened up about the immense pressure he felt, while mainstream recognition rolled in including a congratulatory message from Assassin's Creed UK.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Breaks Nose at AEW All In in Women's World Championship Win
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone captured the AEW Women's World Championship at Wembley Stadium by defeating Willow Nightingale, though she suffered a broken nose in the opening moments of the match. Mone fought through the injury to force Nightingale to pass out in the Statement Maker after a chaotic, hard-hitting bout. The victory makes Mone the first woman to hold world titles in AEW, WWE, and CMLL.

stories.title: Jamie Hayter Comments on Britt Baker's All In Return and Tag Championship Win
stories.tldr: At AEW All In, Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor captured the Women's Tag Team Championships from Divine Dominion to thrill the Wembley Stadium crowd. Britt Baker also made a surprise return on the pre-show, leading Hayter to address their complicated history and potential future interactions. The Brawling Birds ended the former champions' 168-day reign with their Two Birds One Stone finisher.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 Reviews and Ticket Sales Updates
stories.tldr: AEW recently wrapped up its All In 2026 event at Wembley Stadium, drawing nearly 45,000 distributed tickets and closing with Will Ospreay capturing the world championship. Critical reception highlighted major moments like Britt Baker's return and the debut of Austin Creed and Kofi, alongside mixed reactions to the pre-show. Additionally, early ticket sales figures have emerged for upcoming autumn events like All Out, WrestleDream, and Full Gear.

stories.title: Kenny Omega on All In Title Loss and Passing Torch to Will Ospreay
stories.tldr: Following their highly anticipated rubber match at Wembley Stadium, Will Ospreay defeated Kenny Omega in the main event of AEW All In 2026 to capture the AEW World Championship. Ospreay made history as the first English wrestler to win a major world title on home soil by kicking out of the One-Winged Angel and securing the pin. In the aftermath, Omega publicly passed the torch to the new champion on social media.

stories.title: Kazuchika Okada Wins International Championship at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Kazuchika Okada captured the AEW International Championship at Wembley Stadium by defeating Kyle Fletcher and Konosuke Takeshita in an all-Callis Family triple threat match. The chaotic bout ended when Okada hit the Rainmaker on Fletcher following a flurry of near-falls and stablemate miscommunication. Post-match tensions arose before Don Callis intervened to force Fletcher into raising Okada's hand. The blockbuster event also featured a wave of other championship changes and surprise returns across the card.

stories.title: Britt Baker Returns at AEW All In to Help Persephone Win TBS Title
stories.tldr: Despite reports claiming she would miss the event, Britt Baker made a surprise return at AEW All In London during the Buy In pre-show. Disguised in a mask, Baker interfered in the TBS Championship match, pushing Maya World off the top rope to help Persephone secure the victory and the title. After the match, Baker locked World in the Lockjaw and unmasked to a massive ovation from the Wembley Stadium crowd, later revealing an alliance with the new double champion.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Wresltes at RevPro Before AEW All In
stories.tldr: Following his surprise appearance at Revolution Pro Wrestling the night before AEW All In, Will Ospreay and Tony Khan have addressed the high-stakes decision. Ospreay explained that honoring his roots and supporting RevPro owner Andy Quildan was super important to him, especially given their history together. Khan admitted that Ospreay played with fire by wrestling so close to headlining Wembley Stadium, but ultimately trusted the star's judgment. The gamble paid off, as Ospreay successfully competed at both events and captured the AEW World Championship.

stories.title: Post-AEW All In Dynamite Lineup Announcements
stories.tldr: Following the conclusion of All In, AEW announced the initial match card and segments for the upcoming post-PPV edition of Dynamite in Texas. Newly crowned AEW World Trios Champions Swerve Strickland and New Level will defend their newly won titles against The Rascalz. Additionally, newly minted Women's World Champion Mercedes Mone will host a special championship celebration segment.

stories.title: Cope & Cage Defeat Young Bucks at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland and Christian Cage successfully defended the AEW World Tag Team Championship against The Young Bucks at All In following a hard-fought battle at Wembley Stadium. After Christian used a loaded elbow pad and Copeland delivered a decisive Spear to secure the win, the champions were immediately confronted in the ring. Motor City Machine Guns, a returning FTR, and the newly crowned trios champions New Level all staked their claim for a future title opportunity.

stories.title: Andrade El Idolo Wins Casino Gauntlet Match at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo triumphed in the Casino Gauntlet match at AEW All In, entering as the very first participant to set a new match record. After surviving an eleven-person field that featured a chaotic sequence involving MJF and Nick Wayne, Andrade stole the winning pinfall. He has now earned a guaranteed future opportunity at the AEW World Championship against the winner of Kenny Omega versus Will Ospreay.

stories.title: Jon Moxley Wins Continental Challenge Cup at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley successfully defended his Continental Championship and won the inaugural Continental Challenge Cup against Nigel McGuinness at AEW All In. In a hard-fought battle at Wembley Stadium, Moxley targeted his opponent's injured ankle throughout the 17-minute bout. Ultimately, Moxley forced McGuinness to submit to a grueling ankle lock after delivering a curb stomp. The emotional match concluded with a rousing ovation from the London crowd for McGuinness.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Expresses Gratitude to Tony Khan for Surgery Costs
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay has revealed that AEW President Tony Khan personally covered the astronomical cost of his neck surgery last year, which totaled over $420,000. While Ospreay noted he could have afforded the procedure himself, Khan's financial support deeply impressed him and highlighted the promoter's care for his talent. This continues a pattern of Khan paying for major medical procedures for both contracted and non-contracted wrestlers, including Mark Davis, Eddie Kingston, and The Blade.

stories.title: Thekla Makes Return at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Thekla officially made her surprise return to AEW during the All In Zero Hour pre-show at Wembley Stadium following the TBS Championship match. Interrupting the broadcast panel, she declared her comeback and teased that things in the company are about to get Toxic again. Her appearance ends an absence that began after she lost the women's title in July.

stories.title: Willow Nightingale All In Tribute Plans
stories.tldr: Following the recent passing of music legend Dolly Parton at age 80, tributes have poured in from across the wrestling industry. AEW star Willow Nightingale is now planning a unique tribute to Parton and Tim Curry at the upcoming All In event in London. During her match against Mercedes Mone, Nightingale will adopt a campy, elevated look to honor the late icons. She stated that the ultimate way to pay respect to them is to spread kindness and be herself.

stories.title: Jackson Drake Wins NXT North American Title & Myles Borne Turns Heel
stories.tldr: At WWE NXT Heatwave, Myles Borne suffered a disastrous night by losing both of his championships to the faction Vanity Project. First, Borne and Tavion Heights dropped the NXT Tag Team Championship to Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes, and later, Borne lost the NXT North American Championship to Jackson Drake following outside interference. Frustrated by the losses and the collapse of his title reign, Borne shockingly turned heel by attacking his tag partner Heights with his Borne Again finisher. The betrayal leaves Heights laying in the ring and sets up an explosive new feud between the former friends.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Injured/Helped Backstage at WWE Live Event
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens was helped backstage and appeared to be limping following his match at a WWE live event in South Carolina. Local footage captured the veteran receiving assistance, sparking concerns over a potential knee injury just weeks after his return to the ring. WWE has not yet officially confirmed the nature or severity of the situation. This latest scare comes on the heels of a long layoff due to a complex neck surgery that nearly ended his career.

stories.title: WWE NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 Date Announced
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced that NXT Halloween Havoc 2026 will take place on Saturday, October 31, marking the first time the historic event is actually held on Halloween night. NXT General Manager Robert Stone revealed the date during a backstage segment at the Heatwave Premium Live Event. The show will air live on The CW, though WWE has not yet announced a host city or venue.

stories.title: Zaria Unifies NXT Women's North American and Speed Championships at Heatwave
stories.tldr: At WWE NXT Heatwave 2026 in Edinburg, Texas, NXT Women's North American Champion Zaria made history by winning a triple threat match against Women's Speed Champion Wren Sinclair and Kali Armstrong to officially unify the two titles. The bout originally stemmed from a feud between Zaria and Sinclair, with Armstrong later earning her way into the match by defeating Zaria on television. Zaria secured the historic victory by pinning Armstrong after a chaotic contest featuring high-impact maneuvers from all three competitors. Industry observers note that this women's title unification may signal the eventual phase-out of the men's Speed Championship as well.

stories.title: WWE Live Event Ticket Sales Update
stories.tldr: Recent industry reports have provided an updated look at ticket sales for upcoming professional wrestling events scheduled throughout the fall of 2026. The figures highlight strong demand for a variety of television tapings, premium live events, and major international cards across multiple cities. Major upcoming spectacles like Survivor Series and TripleMania are already drawing massive crowds as ticket distribution continues to grow.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Reflects on Early Days with WWE
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Kevin Nash recently reflected on the financial struggles of his early days working in WWE as Diesel. Despite being a prominent fixture on television as Shawn Michaels bodyguard and an Intercontinental Champion, Nash revealed he was initially compensated on a lower manager pay scale. Meanwhile, Michaels has previously credited Nash for helping elevate him to the main event scene while forging a strong bond through their mutual backstage antics.

stories.title: JBL Names Greatest Tag Team of All Time
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer JBL recently discussed his pick for the greatest tag team in professional wrestling history, drawing from his own extensive background in tag team competition. Comparing their untouchable status to legendary manager and broadcaster Bobby Heenan, JBL declared The Road Warriors as the undisputed greatest duo of all time. He highlighted their unmatched crowd connection and the famous Road Warrior Pop as a measuring stick for popularity that has never been replicated.

stories.title: Cruz Montana on Biggest Difference Working for WWE
stories.tldr: Cruz Montana, formerly known as Mike Santana, recently discussed the major adjustments he experienced after transitioning from TNA Wrestling to WWE NXT. The former TNA World Champion noted that observing the company operation from the stands at Battleground last year revealed a massive, well-oiled machine. Montana particularly praised the strict routine, high level of organization, and television-focused structure that sets the promotion apart from everywhere else he has worked. Now officially signed as of July 2026, he is currently channeling that appreciation for structure while chasing Tony D'Angelo's NXT championship.

stories.title: Grayson Waller Wins WWE NXT Championship at Heatwave
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller captured the NXT Championship at Heatwave by stealing the pin from Cruz Montana in a chaotic fatal four-way match involving Zilla Fatu and Tony D'Angelo. The victory ends D'Angelo's 148-day title reign and marks Waller's second championship win in WWE. Following the broadcast, Waller celebrated his massive victory by performing his signature off-air shoey in the middle of the ring.

stories.title: Kelani Jordan Wins WWE NXT Women's Championship at Heatwave
stories.tldr: Kelani Jordan successfully backed up her bold words by defeating Kendal Grey at NXT Heatwave to capture her first NXT Women's Championship. Jordan capitalized on Grey's lingering storyline ear injury during a hard-hitting encounter, ending Grey's title reign at 63 days. The challenger secured the milestone victory by driving Grey into an exposed turnbuckle before landing her signature split-legged moonsault.

stories.title: The Vanity Project Wins NXT Tag Team Championship at Heatwave
stories.tldr: The Vanity Project kicked off NXT Heatwave by capturing the tag team titles from Myles Borne and Tavion Heights. Ricky Smokes and Brad Baylor secured the victory after utilizing friendly fire to isolate Borne for the finish. Borne now stands one title down with his North American Championship defense against Jackson Drake still ahead.

stories.title: WWE NXT Heatwave 2026 Reviews and Betting Odds
stories.tldr: NXT Heatwave 2026 has concluded, featuring a massive night of title changes that saw Grayson Waller capture the NXT Championship and Zaria unify the Women's North American and Speed titles. Myles Borne dropped his championships as projected, while Jaida Parker successfully tapped out Nattie in their submission match. The event also sparked discussion due to its scheduling overlap with AEW All In.

stories.title: Jaida Parker Defeats Nattie at NXT Heatwave
stories.tldr: Following events previously covered in NXT, Jaida Parker and Nattie settled their months-long feud in a physical submission match at NXT Heatwave. Parker emerged victorious in the rubber match by forcing Nattie to tap out to her own signature Sharpshooter. The controversial finish and Nattie tapping to her own move sparked heavy backlash and debate among fans online.

stories.title: WWE NXT Lineup Announced for Post-Heatwave Episode
stories.tldr: Following the Heatwave premium live event, WWE has announced the match card for the September 1 episode of NXT from the Performance Center in Orlando. The upcoming show will feature major fallout from Heatwave alongside three newly confirmed matches and a previously scheduled bout. The card kicks off the brand's new road toward Halloween Havoc.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu NXT Debut at Heatwave
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu made his highly anticipated in-ring debut at NXT Heatwave, challenging for the NXT Championship in a chaotic main event. Despite coming close to victory after hitting his running Samoan Spike, interference from Grayson Waller derailed his chances. Waller ultimately capitalized on the chaos to pin Tony D'Angelo and capture the NXT Championship, marking a turbulent debut night for Fatu.

stories.title: AAA Triplemania 34 Match Announcements
stories.tldr: Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide has announced major match lineups for TripleMania 34 following the Ola de Calor event in Edinburg, Texas. Night one in Las Vegas will feature a high-stakes clash between Rey Mysterio and an indefinitely suspended Omos, where Mysterio's career on the line is replaced by a stipulation that Omos will be permanently gone from AAA if he loses, or reinstated if he wins. Meanwhile, Night two in Mexico City is shaping up with a four-way Cruiserweight Championship match, Dominik Mysterio defending the Mega Championship against El Grande Americano, and La Catalina challenging Flammer for the Reina de Reinas title.

stories.title: EC3 Hospitalized with Serious Leg Infection
stories.tldr: Former TNA World Champion EC3 has been hospitalized with a serious leg infection that he contracted following a recent trip to a Gathering in the woods. After initially being sent home from the hospital when he first sought treatment, his condition worsened over five days, leading to his eventual admission. He currently has no timetable for his return to the ring, but he assured fans he is doing fine while passing the time by reading, watching Christopher Nolan movies, and writing manifestos.

stories.title: CM Punk Teased for WWE/AAA Worlds Collide
stories.tldr: CM Punk was featured in a promotional video during the AAA Ola de Calor event on August 30, teasing a nostalgic return of his infamous Straight Edge Society mask for the upcoming WWE and AAA Worlds Collide event. The crossover show is scheduled for September 26 at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, and will feature talent from the WWE main roster, NXT, and Lucha Libre AAA. Punk previously hinted at dusting off the masked gimmick during an appearance at San Diego Comic Con, noting that the partnership with AAA provides the perfect opportunity to revisit the persona. While the reigning Undisputed WWE Champion is advertised for the Chicago card, an official match has not yet been announced.

stories.title: Joey Janela Cutters and Bronson Reed Social Media Exchange
stories.tldr: Joey Janela engaged in a playful social media exchange with Bronson Reed after Reed publicly requested that wrestlers stop using the cutter maneuver, excluding Randy Orton. Challenged by Reed to hit multiple cutters, Janela escalated the count during his match and ultimately delivered four of them just to troll his fellow wrestler. Despite hitting the signature move a remarkable four times, Janela still lost the match, while Reed reacted to the video with amusement.

stories.title: Jordynne Grace at Sycho Sid Memorial Benefit Show
stories.tldr: Current wrestling talent Jordynne Grace recently participated in the first annual Sycho Sid Memorial Benefit Show in Memphis, Tennessee. The event was organized by Gunnar Eudy, the son of the late legendary wrestler Sid Eudy, also known as Sycho Sid. During the event, Grace entered a battle royal where she was ultimately eliminated by Cowboy Seth. Seth has historical ties to the wrestling business, having previously appeared on screen with Sid Eudy in WCW and serving as his real-life neighbor in Arkansas.

stories.title: Xia Brookside Cites WWE Star as Inspiration
stories.tldr: TNA star Xia Brookside recently revealed that former WWE Divas Champion Saraya served as a major inspiration for her professional wrestling career. Growing up in a British wrestling family, Brookside looked up to her trailblazing compatriot who achieved massive global success at a young age. Now holding the TNA Knockouts World Champion title herself, Brookside reflects on the surreal nature of realizing her dreams in the United States.

stories.title: Ric Flair Threatens Legal Action Over Robes Sale
stories.tldr: Ric Flair is threatening legal action against individuals attempting to sell his iconic wrestling robes without valid proof of ownership or receipts. Following a recent appearance in Philadelphia, the Nature Boy specifically accused a woman named Tiffany VanDemark of stealing five of his robes. Flair emphasized that preserving his career memorabilia has become increasingly important to him as he ages, warning that possessing stolen property is a serious felony. He even took to social media to mock skeptics by claiming his robes are now worth more than a house before heading to an airport bar.

stories.title: Wrestling Legend Paul LeDuc Passes Away
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestler and promoter Paul LeDuc, famous as one half of the LeDuc Brothers alongside his close friend Jos LeDuc, has passed away at the age of 89. Throughout his career starting in 1957, he captured major tag team titles across Grand Prix Wrestling, NWA Florida, and NWA International. He also made history by participating in a 1971 wrestling wedding in Montreal and later founding his own promotion, the FLQ, in 2000. Wrestling historian Pat Laprade shared the news of his passing, and LeDuc is survived by his sons Carl and Yan, and his daughter Kim.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Challenges Steve Maclin for MLP Northern Rising
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland has officially challenged Steve Maclin for a match at Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling's Northern Rising event after Maclin questioned why Canadian wrestlers leave their home country. In response, Copeland highlighted his global career and proposed a showdown on October 3 at the historic Maple Leaf Gardens in Toronto. Before turning his full attention to Maclin, Copeland is scheduled to team with Cage to defend the AEW World Tag-Team Championships against The Young Bucks at AEW All In: London.

stories.title: AAA Heatwave / Ola de Calor Show Discussions and Title Changes
stories.tldr: AAA Ola de Calor delivered major title changes and TripleMania match setups in Texas. La Parka captured the newly redesigned Latin American Championship in a four-way match involving Damian Priest. Additionally, the cruiserweight contendership match ended in a draw, leading to a four-way title bout at TripleMania, where La Catalina also earned a women's title shot.

stories.title: Scott Steiner's Son Brock Rechsteiner Waived by Saints
stories.tldr: Following his viral training camp altercation, Brock Rechsteiner has officially been waived by the New Orleans Saints. The son of Scott Steiner was also dealing with a six game suspension for a performance enhancing substance policy violation. With his NFL stint cut short, attention now turns to his pending transition into professional wrestling. Rechsteiner previously signed a WWE NIL deal and has discussed following his family into the business.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Daily Update and Notes
stories.tldr: Following the buildup in London, the weekend was dominated by massive fallout from AEW All In at Wembley Stadium and WWE NXT Heatwave. Major developments include Will Ospreay defeating Kenny Omega for the World Title, Mercedes Mone winning the Women's World Title despite sustaining an injury, and several surprise returns and debuts. Additionally, passing news notes the death of Paul LeDuc and updates regarding Brock Rechsteiner's potential move to WWE.

stories.title: TBS Championship Match Added to AEW All In London Buy-In
stories.tldr: Maya World will defend her AEW TBS Championship against CMLL World Women's Champion Persephone on the Buy-In pre-show for AEW All In London. The match was set up after Persephone attacked World with the title belt on Dynamite following a previous singles encounter in July. AEW President Tony Khan confirmed the pre-show bout after World issued a defiant challenge from inside Wembley Stadium during Collision.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Reflects on Wembley Stadium and Career Milestones
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland has opened up about checking Wembley Stadium off his bucket list ahead of his AEW World Tag Team Championship match alongside Christian Cage against The Young Bucks at All In. In a recent interview, Copeland also reflected with great pride on launching WWE's Judgment Day faction and helping shape the early career of Dominik Mysterio. Additionally, he discussed the winding narrative path that eventually reunited him and Cage as tag team partners in AEW under Tony Khan's guidance.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 Set and Stage Revealed at Wembley Stadium
stories.tldr: AEW has officially pulled back the curtain on its massive stage and production setup for All In 2026 at Wembley Stadium in London. Following early construction photos leaking online, AEW released a cinematic drone video showcasing the towering entrance structure, custom lighting rigs, massive video board, and the overhead ring roof. The event takes place on Sunday, August 30, marking the company's return to the historic venue after a one-year gap, featuring a loaded match card headlined by Kenny Omega defending the AEW World Championship against Will Ospreay.

stories.title: Mike Bailey Criticizes Social Media Platform X (Twitter)
stories.tldr: During a recent interview with POST Wrestling, Mike Bailey discussed how leveraging social media helped him maintain a connection with American fans during his five-year ban from entering the United States. While he believes social media is essential for modern wrestlers to build their brands and engage fans beyond television, he harshly criticized Twitter as an awful place plagued by ruined, politically biased algorithms and constant trolling. Bailey also touched on his upcoming appearance in the Casino Gauntlet match at AEW All In in London.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Makes Surprise Appearance at RevPro 14th Anniversary
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay made a surprise return to Revolution Pro Wrestling at their 14th Anniversary Show just one day before headlining AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. Acting as the mystery partner for CPF, Ospreay teamed with Callum Newman, Danny Black, Joe Lando, and Maverick Mayhew to defeat the heel team in a ten-man tag match. After picking up the win with a Hidden Blade on Mark Trew, Ospreay addressed Newman in the ring and asked his former United Empire stablemate to be in his corner for his AEW World Championship match against Kenny Omega. Following a brief moment of tension, Newman embraced Ospreay, heavily teasing a surprise appearance at Wembley.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Asks Callum Newman to Be in His Corner at AEW All In
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay made a surprise appearance at the RevPro 14-Year Anniversary show just before challenging Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship at AEW All In. During the event, Ospreay teamed with CPF and publicly asked his former protege, NJPW star Callum Newman, to be in his corner at Wembley Stadium. After an initial moment of hesitation where Newman dropped the microphone and walked away, he turned back to embrace Ospreay, confirming he will return the favor from when Ospreay supported his historic IWGP Heavyweight Championship win.

stories.title: FTR Captures RevPro Tag Team Championship Ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Tag Team Champions FTR made a surprise return to the independent scene at the RevPro 14th Anniversary show. Dax Harwood and Cash Wheeler defeated the Cowboy Way duo of 1 Called Manders and Thomas Shire in a hard-hitting, bloody encounter to capture the Undisputed British Tag Team Championship for the first time. This marks FTR's first championship win since taking time away from television following their loss at AEW Double or Nothing in May. Fans are now speculating whether the decorated tag team will make a surprise appearance at AEW All In London to reignite past feuds.

stories.title: AEW Referee Aubrey Edwards Briefly Wins Attack! 24/7 Championship
stories.tldr: AEW referee Aubrey Edwards made a surprise appearance at Mystery Wrestling and captured the ATTACK! 24/7 Championship from comedian Ron Funches. To secure the pinfall, Edwards resorted to unorthodox tactics by landing a low-blow on the comedian. Immediately after her victory, she took the microphone to declare that she is not a wrestler and promptly vacated the title. By giving up the championship right away, she avoided spending AEW All In weekend constantly defending the belt under its frantic 24/7 rules.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy Disliked Merging International and Continental Titles
stories.tldr: Orange Cassidy recently revealed during an interview with Adrian Hernandez that he strongly disliked AEW's decision to merge the International and Continental championships. Cassidy, a two-time International Champion who defined much of the belt's early history and prestige, felt the unification disrespected the hard work put into building its separate identity. Despite his lingering disappointment over the merger, he expressed immense pride in seeing elite talent like Kyle Fletcher, Kazuchika Okada, and Konosuke Takeshita continue to elevate the championship's legacy.

stories.title: Don Callis Attempts to Recruit Sting's Son
stories.tldr: Don Callis attempted to recruit Sting's son, Steven Borden, on AEW Collision after Borden attacked TNT Champion Kevin Knight to get payback for his friend Darby Allin. Callis praised Borden's athletic potential and tried to convince him to join the Callis Family instead of listening to Allin. Borden rejected the pitch by delivering a warning from Allin that he will challenge Knight for the TNT title at All In, which resulted in Knight punching Borden. This segment marked Borden's first on-screen mic work and physical altercation as AEW eases him into television.

stories.title: Deonna Purrazzo Recalls Asthma Attack During 2024 CMLL Match
stories.tldr: Deonna Purrazzo has revealed that she suffered a severe asthma attack during her 2024 CMLL match against La Catalina, which was poorly received and negatively impacted her career. Responding to a fan comparison on social media, Purrazzo defended her performance and stated she has faced repercussions for two years, resulting in a reduced presence on television. The revelation follows a similar recent disclosure by Athena regarding an asthma attack at an ROH event.

stories.title: AEW Tag Team Teases Split Ahead of All In
stories.tldr: As AEW All In 2026 approaches at Wembley Stadium, several prominent tag teams and factions find themselves facing potential splits and simmering tensions. From longtime allies like the Brawling Birds and Adam Copeland with Christian Cage to complex stables like The Conglomeration and The Young Bucks, high-stakes matches could lead to dramatic breakups. These looming divisions threaten to reshape the AEW tag team and trios landscapes as wrestlers pivot toward new rivalries or solo paths.

stories.title: Tony Khan Praises UK Wrestling Fans Ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan recently discussed his excitement for AEW All In 2026 returning to Wembley Stadium on August 30. During a conversation with Jack Whitehall, Khan highlighted the rich history of wrestling on ITV and explained why UK fans provide an unmatched live atmosphere. He boldly claimed that English wrestling crowds are the loudest and most passionate in the entire world, comparing their energetic chants and songs to football matches.

stories.title: Alex Windsor Comments on Will Ospreay's High-Risk Style
stories.tldr: Alex Windsor recently admitted that she has completely given up trying to talk her partner Will Ospreay out of performing dangerous wrestling stunts. Speaking with SHAK Wrestling, she recalled stressing over his terrifying Spanish Fly spot off the top of a steel cage with Kyle Fletcher. Even after backstage agents like Christopher Daniels expressed doubt, Ospreay still went through with the high-risk maneuver. Windsor ultimately learned that once Ospreay sets his mind on a spot, trying to stop him is a waste of time.

stories.title: Darby Allin Comments on AEW World Title Reign
stories.tldr: Darby Allin recently reflected on his hectic 39-day AEW World Championship reign that concluded when he dropped the belt back to Maxwell Jacob Friedman. Despite some fan criticism regarding the brief tenure, Allin embraced the intense pressure and defended the championship multiple times to rewrite the traditional champion script. Drawing inspiration from successfully climbing Mount Everest despite outside doubt, he wanted to provide multiple competitors with opportunities just as early matches helped elevate his own career. Looking ahead, Allin is now set to challenge AEW TNT Champion Kevin Knight at the upcoming All In event.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné Praises Creative Freedom in AEW
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone reflects on how her move to AEW has revitalized her professional wrestling career through unprecedented creative freedom. She explains that being able to construct her own matches and collaborate without fear has unlocked her career-best performances in the ring. Additionally, she breaks character to praise her AEW peers, noting that the hungry and diverse women's division constantly pushes her to elevate her game.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Teases Fans Ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: Former AEW Mens World Champion Swerve Strickland recently shared a cryptic one-word social media post featuring the word New ahead of the upcoming All In event. This post has fueled speculation that former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods, who recently left their previous promotion as free agents, are imminently joining the All Elite roster. Reports indicate the duo could soon debut as Strickland partners in a major championship match.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Coverage from London Ahead of All In
stories.tldr: Jim Valley hosts a special Saturday edition of Wrestling Observer Live directly from London, England, as the city prepares to host AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. The broadcast begins with a comprehensive recap of the 60th anniversary of the Cauliflower Alley Club event in Las Vegas, highlighting major award recipients like Bret Hart, Ric Flair, the Glamour Girls, Tony Atlas, and Bill Apter. Following the convention retrospective, the show transitions into an in-depth preview of Sunday's upcoming All In event. Valley shares insights on what fans can expect from the historic card and details the unique atmosphere of experiencing the massive stadium show live.

stories.title: Paul Wight Questions Wrestlers Pushing Back on Creative
stories.tldr: AEW star and veteran Paul Wight recently discussed his perspective on modern wrestling creative in an interview with TMZ Sports. Having transitioned from a decorated in-ring career to commentary, Wight advised younger talent to stop taking losses so seriously and stressing over their perceived weakness. He emphasized that professional wrestling is scripted entertainment akin to acting, and wrestlers should honor their contracts rather than refusing to put opponents over. Ultimately, Wight suggests that talent unhappy with a creative direction should collaborate on constructive alternatives rather than fighting the process.

stories.title: AEW All In Buy-In Card Additions and Matches Announced
stories.tldr: AEW has expanded the All In Buy-In pre-show into a five-match card with several last-minute additions finalized right after Collision. Newly announced bouts feature Maya World defending the TBS Championship against Persephone, and Kris Statlander reuniting with Harley Cameron to face the Sisters of Sin. Additionally, high-profile eight-man tag team matches involving the Hurt Syndicate and the Opps have rounded out the lineup.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 Betting Odds
stories.tldr: Final betting odds for AEW All In 2026 point to a night of sweeping title changes at Wembley Stadium. In addition to Will Ospreay's commanding lead over Kenny Omega, heavy movement favors challengers like Mercedes Mone, The Young Bucks, and The Brawling Birds to capture gold. Updated lines also clarify the outlook for the TNT and International championships ahead of today's card.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 Ticket Sales and Event Preview
stories.tldr: With AEW All In returning to Wembley Stadium tomorrow, ticket distribution has ticked up to nearly 44,000. The full nine-match card features major championship bouts, including Kenny Omega defending the Men's World Title against Will Ospreay and Willow Nightingale putting the Women's Championship on the line against Mercedes Mone. Additionally, heavy speculation surrounds potential high-profile surprises in the Casino Gauntlet match and throughout the card.

stories.title: The New Day Expected to Make AEW Debut at All In
stories.tldr: Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed have officially finalized a deal with AEW and are set to make their promotional debut at All In. The duo will team up with Swerve Strickland as a mystery wild card entry in the Trios Roulette Royale match. Upon arrival, they will debut a brand new tag team name as they embark on their first wrestling matches outside of the WWE system in nearly two decades.

stories.title: Previewing Will Ospreay vs. Kenny Omega Match
stories.tldr: As Will Ospreay and Kenny Omega prepare for their AEW World Championship rubber match at Wembley Stadium, Don Callis has predicted it will be the greatest match ever due to Omega entering the bout in a zen mental state. Analysts are also viewing the high-stakes clash as a potential closing chapter for the cross-promotional New Japan era that helped define early AEW history. The two stars currently split their previous two singles encounters.

stories.title: AEW Adds Women's Matches to All In Event Card
stories.tldr: Following earlier speculation about potential additions, AEW has officially confirmed a third and fourth women's match for the All In Zero Hour pre-show. TBS Champion Maya World will defend her title against Persephone following a recent belt attack, while a newly reunited Harley Cameron and Kris Statlander will face the Sisters of Sin. These bouts join the previously announced World Championship and Women's Tag Team Championship matches to round out a stacked women's division lineup for Wembley Stadium.

stories.title: Mick Foley Issues UK Appeal Ahead of AEW All In
stories.tldr: Mick Foley recently resolved an incident where fans fled a charity auction with his signed shirts by having them make a donation to the Cauliflower Alley Club. Now arrived in the United Kingdom for AEW All In at Wembley Stadium, the WWE Hall of Famer has unfortunately lost his luggage. To salvage his wardrobe for the big event, Foley has issued an urgent appeal to fans attending the show to help him secure a replacement red-and-black flannel shirt.

stories.title: Don Callis Praises Top AEW Recruit
stories.tldr: Don Callis recently hailed Mark Davis as his greatest recruitment success and a future AEW World Champion. Callis compared the powerhouse to legends like Bruiser Brody and Stan Hansen while discussing the athlete's relentless in-ring style. Davis is now set to prove his manager right as he enters the upcoming Casino Gauntlet match for a championship opportunity.

stories.title: Piper Niven Provides Injury and Recovery Update Following Neck Surgery
stories.tldr: WWE star Piper Niven has provided a positive health update over a year after being sidelined with a major neck injury. Following neck surgery earlier this year, Niven shared her 12 week post-operative scan results on social media, revealing that everything is healing beautifully. Along with thanking fans for their overwhelming support, she indicated she would be stepping away from social media again as she continues her recovery at home in Florida.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels on NXT Vision and Comparison to His WWF Title Run
stories.tldr: WWE Senior Vice President of Talent Development Creative Shawn Michaels recently appeared on Busted Open Radio to discuss his unique vision for NXT, emphasizing that he wants the brand to stand on its own rather than become a watered-down version of Raw or SmackDown. During the appearance, Michaels also drew a parallel between current NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo's reign and his own historical 1996 WWF Championship run. He noted that D'Angelo is currently carrying the brand through a mass exodus of talent departures and call-ups, much like Michaels had to navigate the landscape when major stars left for WCW in the nineties.

stories.title: WWE Files Trademark Application for '946'
stories.tldr: WWE has submitted a cryptic trademark application with the USPTO for the number 946. Filed on August 28, the filing covers standard entertainment and wrestling-related services such as live performances, broadcasting, fan club events, and online content. At this time, there is no official indication from the company regarding how this numerical trademark will be utilized in future programming or promotions.

stories.title: Johnny Gargano's Planking Angle Takes Major Turn on WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: Johnny Gargano finally ended his months-long backstage planking gimmick during the WWE SmackDown tapings in his hometown of Cleveland, Ohio. Prompted by an unexpected WWE Championship opportunity offered by CM Punk and General Manager Nick Aldis, Gargano got back to his feet for his first match in over four months. Although Punk ultimately retained the championship, the homecoming event featured an emotional post-show speech from Gargano reflecting on his journey from a fan in the stands to main eventing against one of his idols.

stories.title: Mark Henry Clarifies Current WWE Employment Status
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mark Henry has clarified that he is not currently employed by the company and does not operate under a legends deal. Despite recent appearances on WWE programming and radio commitments, his only official connection is a nostalgia agreement allowing the company to use his name for merchandise like action figures and video games. Henry continues to support the professional wrestling industry independently by scouting talent, mentoring roughly twenty-five wrestlers who regularly seek his advice, and offering his guidance completely free of charge.

stories.title: Shotzi Blackheart Details Most Proud WWE Moment
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Shotzi Blackheart recently revealed that shaving her head on national television in 2023 to support her sister undergoing chemotherapy is the proudest moment of her career. Addressing her future, Blackheart explained that after her contract expired in May 2025 following an ACL injury, she is currently happy working on the independent scene. However, she still fondly misses her former locker room and continues to tune in to support friends like Chelsea Green.

stories.title: Absent WWE Star Teases Match Against Roman Reigns
stories.tldr: Absent WWE star Bronson Reed has teased a potential rematch against World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns following the announcement of WWE's upcoming tour in Australia. Reed, who has been sidelined for six months with a torn bicep, holds a 1-1 singles record against Reigns and is reportedly very close to making his in-ring return. With additional reports of training updates and backstage praise for his physique, the Australian star appears poised for an imminent comeback to target the top champion.

stories.title: Adam Pearce Addresses Nick Aldis Wrestling and In-Ring Future
stories.tldr: WWE Raw General Manager Adam Pearce recently discussed his parallel career path with SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis. Pearce expressed happiness that Aldis was able to scratch his competitive itch and return to the ring at SummerSlam. However, Pearce made it clear that he has zero personal desire to ever wrestle another professional match himself. While he previously noted he might step back into the ring if WWE management explicitly required it, the 48-year-old executive firmly prefers staying covered up rather than wearing tights again.

stories.title: Jacy Jayne Discusses Alliance With Fatal Influence
stories.tldr: Fatal Influence member Jacy Jayne recently discussed the strong backstage bond and competitive dynamic that drives her stable with allies Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid. Jayne explained that her decade-long friendship with Henley combined with Reid stepping up after joining the group has fueled their massive championship success. The stable currently holds gold across the WWE main roster, with Jayne as Women's United States Champion and Reid and Henley holding tag team titles.

stories.title: Paul Heyman Reflects on Brock Lesnar Ending Undertaker's Streak
stories.tldr: During an appearance on the Six Feet Under podcast, Paul Heyman reflected on Brock Lesnar defeating The Undertaker's undefeated WrestleMania streak at WrestleMania 30, calling it the defining achievement of Lesnar's entire career and the ultimate moment of the modern era. Undertaker discussed suffering a severe concussion during the match due to a combination of physical trauma and late-career rust, though he stressed that Lesnar is an extremely safe worker. Heyman and Undertaker agreed that fans remember the historic finish and stunned crowd reaction far more than the actual wrestling sequence. Ultimately, Heyman elevated the moment to the same historical tier as Hulk Hogan versus Andre the Giant and Steve Austin with Mike Tyson.

stories.title: AJ Styles Reportedly Working AAA & NXT Events in Texas
stories.tldr: AJ Styles is heading to Texas this weekend to work backstage as a producer for upcoming AAA and NXT events. He has been filling in for Terry Taylor, who is currently recovering from knee surgery, taking on these behind-the-scenes duties. Despite being in the building for the doubleheader, he is not expected to make any on-screen television appearances. Even with a competing major pay-per-view taking place this weekend, WWE plans to keep his role strictly backstage.

stories.title: JBL Shares Thoughts on WWE Royal Rumble Schedule
stories.tldr: WWE recently announced that the 2027 Royal Rumble will take place in Glendale, Arizona, in February instead of its traditional January slot. This scheduling shift is driven by WWE's partnership with ESPN to aim to avoid direct competition with the NFL. WWE Hall of Famer JBL recently shared his thoughts on this calendar change, suggesting the event could thrive during the quiet sports weekend prior to the Super Bowl. He also expressed strong support for splitting the Royal Rumble into a two-night event given the extensive duration of the signature 30-person matches.

stories.title: The Great Khali Involved in Car Accident in India
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer The Great Khali miraculously escaped injury when his SUV was involved in a traffic collision near the Panipat toll plaza in India. Although his vehicle sustained noticeable damage, no one involved in the accident was hurt, and Khali was able to transfer to another vehicle to continue his journey toward Sonipat. This frightening incident occurred just days after the 54-year-old wrestling legend made headlines for joining the TrueHope Foundation to aid families severely affected by recent flooding in Assam.

stories.title: Ridge Holland Recalls Brawling Brutes Run and Learning From Sheamus
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Luke Menzies, formerly known as Ridge Holland, recently reflected on his time in the Brawling Brutes faction alongside Sheamus and Pete Dunne. Speaking on Under The Mat With Simon Miller, Menzies shared humorous insights about their pale complexion, the original group name idea, and his supporting role in the stable. He also touched upon his recent WWE departure and the chaotic nature of creative decisions during his time with the company.

stories.title: Backstage Update on WWE's Plans for the John Cena Classic
stories.tldr: WWE is currently targeting December 12 for the upcoming John Cena Classic tournament, an event originally announced by John Cena at Backlash. The showcase is expected to spotlight newer and younger talent from both the main roster and NXT, and it may even feature a championship. However, this tentative date creates a direct scheduling conflict with the previously announced Wrestlepalooza: Perth event in Australia. Final details regarding the broadcast platform, venue location, participants, and tournament format remain unfinalized.

stories.title: Bully Ray Explains Why Paul Heyman Won't Acknowledge ECW
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Paul Heyman is widely celebrated for his historic role running ECW, yet he rarely acknowledges the defunct hardcore promotion on social media. According to ECW original Bully Ray on Busted Open Radio, this silence stems from Heyman's relentless focus on current and future success rather than past glories. Bully Ray explained that memories of ECW do not sell tickets today, and WWE employs Heyman for his ongoing contributions rather than his past resume.

stories.title: NXT Heatwave 2026 Updated Odds
stories.tldr: Betting odds have been released for NXT Heatwave 2026, which emanates tomorrow from the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas. Tony D Angelo is favored to retain his NXT Championship in a fatal four-way match, while Myles Borne is projected to drop both of his titles. Meanwhile, Jaida Parker stands as the biggest favorite of the entire card heading into her submission match against Nattie.

stories.title: Trick Williams Credits Family for Trash-Talking Promo Skills
stories.tldr: WWE star Trick Williams recently stated in an interview that he considers himself one of the best trash talkers in the company, capable of hanging on the microphone with veterans like CM Punk. Williams credits his exceptional promo skills to his family background, noting that talking trash is deeply embedded in his DNA. He specifically draws his vibrant personality and charisma from his father, Patrick Belton, and his uncle, known as Sweet Baby James. Furthermore, it was his uncle who inspired his signature Lemon Pepper Steppers footwear that he proudly wears on television every week.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Reflects on Sami Zayn Winning World Championship
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens recently opened up about watching his lifelong friend and rival, Sami Zayn, capture the Undisputed WWE Championship at Night of Champions 2026. The two have shared a deeply intertwined 24-year history spanning the independent scene and WWE, evolving from traveling partners to brothers. Although Zayn's title reign lasted only nine days before dropping it to CM Punk, Owens made a point to visit Raw to celebrate the milestone with him. Today, despite their current on-screen rivalry over the championship picture, their real-life bond remains as strong as ever.

stories.title: Royce Keys and OTM Faction Name and Main Roster WWE Plans Revealed
stories.tldr: The newly formed main roster faction consisting of Royce Keys, Bronco Nima, and Lucien Price has officially been named 946, referencing an Oakland zip code. Backstage creative plans for the trio include comparisons to dominant stables like The Shield and The Nexus, with internal discussions already pointing toward a potential WarGames match. This major alliance came together after WWE abruptly scrapped previous plans to break up OTM and send Nima to AAA.

stories.title: Bully Ray Praises Enzo Amore's Promo Skills
stories.tldr: Bully Ray recently suggested that WWE bring back Enzo Amore to reunite with Big Cass if Cass fails to get over on his own. Expanding on this, Ray stated on Busted Open Radio that Enzo is currently a better talker than 99 percent of the WWE main roster. Nic Nemeth joined the discussion to praise Enzo's ability to naturally generate legitimate wrestling heat on the independent scene. Meanwhile, speculation about Enzo's potential WWE return was fueled earlier this year when he reportedly paused certain independent bookings.

stories.title: Retrospective Look at WWF SummerSlam at Wembley Stadium
stories.tldr: Expanding on classic SummerSlam retrospectives, archival observer reports highlight the monumental scale of the 1992 Wembley Stadium event alongside a five-star 1994 steel cage classic between Bret and Owen Hart. The historic London show drew over 80,000 fans, though it relied heavily on its two marquee matches. Meanwhile, the 1994 encounter stands out as a masterclass in cage match psychology despite Bret Hart wrestling through a severe strep throat.

stories.title: Joe Gacy Explains Why WWE's Wyatt Sicks Push Fell Apart
stories.tldr: Joe Gacy revealed that the Wyatt Sicks push stalled primarily because creative viewed the faction solely as a single act centered around Bo Dallas rather than individual performers. When Dallas temporarily stepped away during their feud with Karrion Kross, WWE refused to feature the group on television or pursue several pitched backup plans. These rejected ideas included weekly character vignettes and a storyline where the Final Testament dismantled the group in Dallas's absence to set up a later return.

stories.title: Nick Hogan Addresses Potential WWE In-Ring Appearance
stories.tldr: Nick Hogan expressed strong praise for WWE management and their ongoing support for his family following the passing of Hulk Hogan. He highlighted the company's hospitality during WrestleMania weekend and discussed plans to collaborate through the upcoming SLAM venue near Madison Square Garden. Furthermore, Nick addressed the possibility of stepping into a WWE ring himself, teasing that fans might see him compete in the future.

stories.title: Backstage Update on Bayley's WWE Contract Status
stories.tldr: Bayley has been absent from television following a sighting at a recent independent wrestling event alongside other talents. Despite her time away, WWE has continued to mention her name on television in ongoing storylines involving Lyra Valkyria. Backstage reports indicate that company officials believe she is likely to sign a new contract due to these continued creative references. However, Bayley has not yet publicly confirmed whether she has officially signed a new deal or plans to leave the promotion.

stories.title: MLW Teases Tessa Blanchard Debut Following Contract Talks
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has strongly hinted at the upcoming debut of Tessa Blanchard through a cryptic promotional vignette featuring diamond imagery and a signature catchphrase. This tease follows confirmation from MLW founder Court Bauer that the promotion has been in direct contract negotiations with the former world champion. Blanchard became a free agent in June after being granted her release from TNA Wrestling and has since remained active with CMLL and upcoming international appearances. While an official signing has not yet been announced by the company, all current indications strongly point toward her imminent arrival on MLW Fusion.

stories.title: Love Pro Wrestling Collaborating With Art Gallery Of Alberta
stories.tldr: Love Pro Wrestling is teaming up with the Art Gallery of Alberta for a historic first-time event on Saturday, November 7, combining live professional wrestling with fine art. The event coincides with the launch of the Ring A Ding Dong Dandy exhibition, which features painted portraits of Stampede Wrestling stars by acclaimed Albertan artist Kim Parrent. Organizers from both organizations express immense excitement for the crossover, which aims to unite the worlds of high-octane in-ring action and local art.

stories.title: Vince Russo Issues Ultimatum to Kerry Morton on JCW Lunacy
stories.tldr: Kerry Morton's career in JCW is in extreme jeopardy after confronting Kaleb Konley for a rematch on the August 29, 2026 episode of JCW Lunacy. Konley flatly rejected the challenge and declared their rivalry over, prompting Vince Russo to intervene via a home office video feed. Russo issued a brutal ultimatum requiring Morton to win three matches over the next three weeks in under five minutes each, or face immediate termination. Morton accepted the high-stakes gamble, leaving fans to wonder if he can survive the gauntlet or if Russo is engineering his firing.

stories.title: The Headbangers Appear on JCW Lunacy
stories.tldr: Former WWE Tag Team Champions The Headbangers made a surprise appearance on the August 29, 2026 episode of JCW Lunacy during a backstage segment with Violent J. What initially seemed like a standard match setup against 2 Tuff Tony and Willie Mack quickly turned hostile when Violent J revealed his true intentions to seek revenge for an incident involving the Insane Clown Posse from several years ago. Instead of a simple nostalgia pop, Mosh and Thrasher were immediately thrust into unfinished business with 2 Tuff Tony and Willie Mack sent to collect the debt. Fans are now left wondering if this is a one-off appearance or the start of an extended run in the company.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Takes Credit for Bringing Ted DiBiase into nWo
stories.tldr: Former WCW executive Eric Bischoff recently took credit on his podcast for bringing WWE Hall of Famer Ted DiBiase into the New World Order as its fourth member. Bischoff explained that he needed a non-wrestling narrative anchor and mouthpiece to speak for the group when the wrestlers were not together, choosing DiBiase strictly for his authoritative voice. DiBiase debuted in the role on August 26, 1996, eventually leaving the faction in August 1997 to manage The Steiner Brothers before leaving WCW in 1999.

stories.title: Indie Spotlight on Teagan Thorne
stories.tldr: Indie wrestler Teagan Thorne channels her real-life survival of a devastating childhood car crash into her gothic Monster High doll wrestling persona. Pronounced dead at the scene after being struck by a drunk driver at age eleven or twelve, she spent weeks in a coma and underwent extensive rehabilitation that left her with permanent brain damage. Discovering professional wrestling during her recovery through stars like Paige and The Shield, she eventually began training in 2019 under the guidance of her father and other coaches. Today, she uses her remarkable second chance at life to appreciate every moment and connect deeply with her fans.

stories.title: Velveteen Dream Disqualified in Bizarre Boxing Debut
stories.tldr: Following his volatile pre-fight press conference, former WWE star Velveteen Dream made his boxing debut against Ryan Pownall at Duel Arena 1, which ended in a bizarre disqualification after Clark repeatedly threw his opponent out of the ring. Despite the official result, Clark has vehemently insisted on social media that he never actually lost the bout. The chaotic event also featured a surreal moment in the crowd when a group was spotted displaying a Nazi flag, prompting a shocked reaction from the former wrestler.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling History: August 29 Titles and Classic Matches
stories.tldr: Moving past the previous date, August 29 features its own massive legacy of legendary matches and championship changes throughout professional wrestling history. Highlights include iconic bouts featuring Bret Hart against both British Bulldog and Owen Hart, alongside a modern five-and-a-half-star classic between Bandido and Hechicero. Major historical title shifts on this date include Ultimate Warrior, Kevin Owens, and Tetsuya Naito claiming championship gold.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Teases Mustafa Ali for TNA Main Event Picture
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy is heavily hinting that TNA plans to elevate reigning International Champion Mustafa Ali into the world title main event picture. Ali is currently sidelined with broken ribs and a punctured lung suffered during a match at TNA Lockdown, forcing him to cancel independent appearances. Despite the injury and hospital bed promos, TNA is not expected to strip him of his championship.

stories.title: CMLL Arena Mexico Results and Attendance Update
stories.tldr: Following his much-anticipated debut, Eddie Kingston fell short in his challenge against CMLL World Heavyweight Champion Hechicero at Arena Mexico. The under-ten-minute match was heavily panned by critics and fans alike, drawing negative reviews for its awkward pacing and abrupt finish. Additionally, the event may have snapped CMLL's impressive 15-show Friday night sellout streak at the historic venue.
